activity_summary: At dinner you said you were not going up. Thomas has the king at two, and you were not there at nine. You did not send anyone to ask how it went. You ate the soft of what was set down. The jaw is still tender, and you did not call it healed. The board was threepence, as on Sunday. You stayed in.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stayed in, kept the cap, and did not send for news.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Fed him soft food and forbade an errand up to the Theatre.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Left the cat on the settle and did not ask how the play went.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Ate, and did not make his trade into a lesson.

facets.activity: Stayed in while Thomas had the king

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I will not have a boy sent to fetch a laugh.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
